people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: by the lot of their inheritance, as Yahweh commanded by Moses, for the nine tribes, and for the half-tribe.
translations.bsb: Their inheritance was assigned by lot for the nine and a half tribes, as the LORD had commanded through Moses.
translations.kjv: By lot was their inheritance, as the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses, for the nine tribes, and for the half tribe.
translations.asv: by the lot of their inheritance, as Jehovah commanded by Moses, for the nine tribes, and for the half-tribe.
